name: Niaprazine
summary: Niaprazine (INN; brand name Nopron) is a sedative-hypnotic drug of the phenylpiperazine group. It has been used in the treatment of sleep disturbances since the early 1970s in several European countries including France, Italy, and Luxembourg. It is commonly used with children and adolescents on account of its favorable safety and tolerability profile and lack of abuse potential.

pharmacology.kind: Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor antagonist; α1-Adrenergic receptor antagonist

uses.text: It has been used in the treatment of sleep disturbances since the early 1970s in several European countries including France, Italy, and Luxembourg. It is commonly used with children and adolescents on account of its favorable safety and tolerability profile and lack of abuse potential.

sideEffects.en: Reported side effects include daytime drowsiness and dry mouth. Sedating drugs of this kind can also cause poor coordination and confusion.
sideEffects.zh: 已報告的副作用包括白天嗜睡與口乾。這類具鎮靜作用的藥物也可能造成協調變差與意識混亂。
sideEffects.zhHans: 已报告的副作用包括白天嗜睡与口干。这类具镇静作用的药物也可能造成协调制差与意识混乱。

fact.en: Niaprazine has been used in France and Italy since the early 1970s, mainly to help children with sleep problems, and it is sold under the name Nopron.
fact.zh: Niaprazine 自 1970 年代初起在法國與義大利使用，主要用於協助有睡眠問題的兒童，商品名為 Nopron。
fact.zhHans: Niaprazine 自 1970 年代初起在法国与意大利使用，主要用于协助有睡眠问题的儿童，商品名为 Nopron。
